## What is this?

- [ ] New link in a curated list

## Checklist

- [ ] Frontmatter parses as valid YAML (skills only)
- [ ] `description` is under 200 characters and names its trigger condition
- [ ] Folder name matches `name` (skills only)
- [ ] All template sections filled in, including Examples
- [ ] Tested at least once in Claude Code or the Claude web interface
- [ ] README list updated if this adds an entry
